note: C8（判定标准二）：platform 业务形状豁免登记——每条必须能回答「为何属技术适配」。只许减不许增；新增须先处置（搬 contract / 归域 / 中性化 / 改名）或在此登记并写明理由。

allowed.com/ragagent/platform/web/ApiResponse.ja: 统一响应壳（全仓 HTTP 响应外壳）——HTTP 技术适配
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/storage/fileserve/: 文件直出 HTTP 面（request/response 进出，与 FileServeHttp/FileTransport 配套）——HTTP 技术适配
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/stream/LiveRunPayl: live-run 标记的 Redis 存储形态（仅 platform.stream 内部消费）——事件/流基建技术适配
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/knowledge/ChunkSea: 跨族共享（knowledge/session/retrieval）+ 依赖 Jackson；判据见 platform/knowledge/package-info
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/knowledge/DocChunk: 跨族共享（agenttools/session）+ 依赖 JsonMappers；判据见 platform/knowledge/package-info
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/knowledge/FaqChunk: 跨族共享（knowledge/agenttools/session）+ 依赖 Jackson；判据见 platform/knowledge/package-info
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/knowledge/GrepChun: 跨族共享（agenttools/session）+ 依赖 Jackson；判据见 platform/knowledge/package-info
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/knowledge/ImageInf: 跨族共享（knowledge/session/wiki）+ 依赖带 Jackson 的 ImageInfoMatchUtil；判据见 platform/knowledge/package-info
platform 内姊妹件 ImageInfoEnricher 复用（8 处），搬走会断链；主码无跨域消费者（retrieval 仅测试引用）；依赖 Jackson
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/knowledge/ImageRef: 跨族共享（knowledge/session）+ 依赖 ImageIO/slf4j；判据见 platform/knowledge/package-info
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/settings/Conversat: 会话配置绑定（@ConfigurationProperties）——G7 评估归位
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/settings/SystemSet: 系统设置解析注册表（语义属 system 域）——G7 归位
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/prompt/AgentPrompt: agent 提示词占位符常量（提示词装载设施）——随提示词治理评估
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/config/RetrievalDr: 检索驱动配置绑定（@ConfigurationProperties）——技术适配
allowed.com/ragagent/platform/stream/MemoryStrea: 进程内流管理器（StreamManager 双实现之一）——流基建技术适配
